title: "Exploratory Data Analysis - Armed Conflict"
format: html
---
```{r}
#| include: false 
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("naniar")
install.packages("quarto")
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)
library(quarto)
```

## Load in data
```{r}
df <- read.csv("./data/processed/final_list.csv", header = TRUE)
```


## Inspect the data 
```{r}
head(df)
glimpse(df)
sum(duplicated(df))
names(df)
summary(df)
```

## Find the missing data
```{r}
colSums(is.na(df))
sum(is.na(df$armed_conflict))
sum(is.na(df$year))

table(df$iso[is.na(df$armed_conflict)])
```

## Examine trends over time
```{r}

conflict_by_year <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_countries = n(),
    conflict_cases = sum(armed_conflict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    no_conflict = sum(armed_conflict == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    conflict_proportion = mean(armed_conflict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#bar chart
ggplot(conflict_by_year, aes(x = year, y = conflict_cases)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Countries Experiencing Armed Conflict by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Countries"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#freq variation of armed conflict by country 
conflict_by_country <- df %>%
  group_by(iso) %>%
  summarise(
    conflict_years = sum(armed_conflict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_years = n(),
    conflict_proportion = mean(armed_conflict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(conflict_years))


```
